experiences.company: TechnoNext Software Ltd. (Concern of US-Bangla Group)

projects.name: Online Travel Agency
projects.description: A multi-tenant OTA platform that enables travel agencies to search, compare, book, and manage flights, hotels, holiday packages, and other travel services.
highlights: Built scalable software solutions for 6 OTA clients including TripLover, TravelChamp, FirstTrip, TakeTrip, TakeOff, & TripLover Dubai
Contributed to the OTA dynamic ecosystem comprising 36+ services, ensuring scalability, high availability, and fault tolerance
Architected and led development of a multi-tenant OTA SaaS project supporting both B2B & B2C business models, enabling a single codebase to serve multiple clients with isolated configurations
Built an automated API integration test suite using xUnit for 30+ supplier integration projects, ensuring consistent API behavior and accelerating release validation
Led the migration of the core database from SQL Server to PostgreSQL, reducing licensing costs and improving cross-platform compatibility on Linux infrastructure
Integrated APM monitoring with Elasticsearch-based structured logging, cutting production failure rates by 30% and dramatically reducing mean-time-to-debug

Developed a background service using ASP.NET Core & Hangfire that automatically cancels un-ticketed bookings before the last ticketing time, reducing ADM penalties by $4,500–$6,400/month per OTA and saving approximately $23,000–$27,000 overall across 6 clients
Implemented key OTA features — Progressive Search, Search Ranking, Universal Split PNR, Refund Reissue, PNR Details
Delivered cloud-native 8 supplier integration projects (Sabre, Travelport, Travelport NDC, Air India, Flydubai, SQ NDC, TK NDC, & Indigo), increasing flight search feed by 27%
Migrated 8 legacy .NET Framework applications to .NET Core, enabling cross-platform deployment on Linux servers and reducing infrastructure costs by eliminating Windows Server licensing
Contributed to CI/CD pipelines and code reviews, and supported onboarding & mentoring of new team members

projects.name: Fare Comparison

Integrated multiple GDS, NDC Suppliers to aggregate competitor fares, flight schedules, and seat availability, normalizing data for accurate comparison and analysis
Engineered pricing-intelligence logic to analyze market data and generate data-driven fare recommendations, helping airlines optimize ticket pricing and maximize revenue
